text:
jules: Quick oneCorpcard soft-decline at SFO Centurion lounge cafe for an espresso + croissant (total $12.20). Receipt printed as 'CARD XX12' and vendor name truncated. Manager gave verbal ok. Can I submit screenshot of pending bank alert + lounge receipt stub?

sam: Hi Jules we usually need merchant name/date/amount. Lounge receipts are common problem. If the bank SMS or pending txn shows the merchant and amount that usually suffices for low-value items. Tag project and add manager note.

lina: Also double-check the corpcard holds policy: if it's a soft-decline but resolves within 7 days it's normal. If it stays pending, finance will ask for a manager-signed memo.

jules: I uploaded the SMS screenshot and the lounge stub to Ramp (expense 9123). Manager approved in-person (Marco).

financebot: Expense 9123 received. Status: pending-review. Missing: clear merchant name. To record exception, manager must reply in this thread with exact phrase 'manager-approved' or upload a signed memo.

marco: manager-approved

financebot: Exception logged. Finance will clear once the transaction posts. If the charge drops off, submit a personal-reimbursement with receipts and manager note. Estimated processing 2-4 business days.

sam: Adding to internal note: for airport lounge purchases < $25, standard exception allowed with (1) pending bank entry or SMS, (2) lounge receipt stub, and (3) manager-approved in-thread. This will be referenced by auditors.

jules: Thanks all saved me a line at the counter :coffee:
